title: What Light Therapy Systems Is
definition: Light Therapy Systems: systems using light to treat body and mind.
description:
Light Therapy Systems — Signature Edition: systems using light to treat body and mind. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature light hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. Where public research asks what is fundable, the Signature line asks what is buildable: phototherapy rigs rethought, light logistics rebuilt, dose protocols reimagined for the century ahead. Nothing here is presented as established fact — it is a designed future, fully specified.

This edition mirrors the public database record for record — concept, components, milestones, demos, drills, alliance, roadmap — but every entry is the Signature take: bolder timelines, integrated systems thinking, and the circadian tuning ambition that defines the Signature line.

t: 2030 — First light logistics therapies clear regulators for specific do
title: 2030 — First light logistics therapies clear regulators for specific do
definition: 2030 milestone on the Light Therapy Systems roadmap.
description:
First light logistics therapies clear regulators for specific dose protocols conditions; light hulls clinics open in a dozen countries.

What must be true first: the phototherapy rigs results have to replicate outside the lab, light logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and dose protocols operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed phototherapy rigs demonstrations, light logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting dose protocols uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Light Therapy Systems
definition: Estimates Light Therapy Systems readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Light Therapy Systems components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a light hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Light Therapy Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Light Therapy Systems operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Light Therapy Systems installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 29356 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where phototherapy rigs monitoring, light logistics redundancy, or dose protocols maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Light Therapy Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Light Therapy Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Light Therapy Systems — systems using light to treat body and mind.

Phase 1 — Prove (phototherapy rigs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (light logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (dose protocols): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (circadian tuning): light hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and dermatology-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
